claim.claim-text: 1. A method of making a semiconductor device, comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the pillar bumps include solder caps.
3. The method of claim 2, wherein the solder caps include lead-free solder.
4. The method of claim 1, further including transfer-mounting the semiconductor die prior to depositing the encapsulant.
5. The method of claim 1, further including singulating the semiconductor die through the encapsulant.
6. The method of claim 5, further including singulating the semiconductor die with a plurality of semiconductor die packaged together.
7. The method of claim 1, wherein the encapsulant covers a front surface and a back surface of the semiconductor die.
8. The method of claim 1, wherein a surface of the encapsulant is coplanar to a surface of the pillar bump.

10. The semiconductor device of claim 9, further including a second semiconductor die disposed in the encapsulant, wherein the encapsulant extends continuously from the first semiconductor die to the second semiconductor die.
11. The semiconductor device of claim 10, further including a printed circuit board, wherein the solder cap is bonded to a conductive trace or contact pad of the printed circuit board.
12. The semiconductor device of claim 9, wherein the solder cap include lead-free solder.

13. The semiconductor device of claim 9, further including a first insulating layer formed over the first semiconductor die, wherein the pillar bump extends through an opening of the first insulating layer to contact the first semiconductor die.
14. The semiconductor device of claim 13, wherein a footprint of the opening is smaller than a footprint of the pillar bump.
15. The semiconductor device of claim 9, wherein the encapsulant covers a front surface and a back surface of the semiconductor die.
